name: sgs/choice-flow
title: SGS Choice Flow
description: A step-by-step quiz that branches to different questions based on the answer given, and ends in a result — not a single flexible form.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Phase 2 (Spec 43 §9) minimum shape — no colour/typography/box attrs declared yet in this phase, so no attrMap. Extend when a later phase adds styling controls.

terminalType.description: The flow's terminal action (Spec 43 §3). Only 'recommendation' (FR-43-3) is supported in this phase; email-capture (FR-43-4) and real-purchase (FR-43-5) terminals arrive in later phases.
